```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
```

```{r}
load("../../data/clinical.rds")
load("../../data/microbiome_metadata.rds")

# need sample year information 
samps <- read_xlsx( file.path(paths$onedrive, "/data/onecodex/2021-10-27_mitox_One Codex Sample Registration.xlsx"))
samps2 <- read_xlsx( file.path(paths$onedrive, "/data/onecodex/2022-07-27_mitox_remaining_One Codex Sample Registration.xlsx")) %>%
   select(-`Specimen Type`)
samps <- rbind(samps, samps2) 
```

# Get sample year 
```{r}
samp.year  <- samps %>%
  select("Barcode ID", "Name") %>%
  mutate(sample_id = gsub("_", ".", Name)) %>%
  mutate(sample_id = gsub(" ", ".", sample_id)) %>%
  select(-Name) %>%
  rename("sample" = "Barcode ID") |>
  mutate(year = case_when(grepl(".20", sample_id) ~ 2020,
                          grepl(".21", sample_id) ~ 2021,
                          grepl(".22", sample_id) ~ 2022,
                          .default = NA)) |>
  select(sample, year)
```


```{r}
df <- mic.meta |>
  left_join(demographics) |>
  left_join(samp.year) |>
  mutate(sample_name = sample,
         sample_title = paste0("MITOX stool metagenome from ", `Patient Id`),
         bioproject_accession = sample,
         organism = "gut metagenome",
         collection_date = year,
         env_broad_scale = "missing	urban biome [ENVO:01000249]",
         env_local_scale = "intestine environment [ENVO:2100002]",
         env_medium = "fecal material [ENVO:00002003]", 
         geo_loc_name = "USA:Ohio",
         host = "Homo sapiens", 
         # generic ohio
         lat_lon = "40.3674 N, 82.9962 W",
         response = Response,
         recist = Category,
         irae = irAE,
         pfs_6m = `6-month PFS`,
         age = Age,
         sex = Sex,
         race = Race,
         bmi = `BMI.(kg/m2)`,
         stage = Stage,
         melanoma_type  = Mel.type, 
         immunotherapy = Treatment, 
         charlson_comorbidity = cci_total,
         recurrence_site = Recurrence.Site.Cat
         ) |>
  select(sample_name, sample_title, bioproject_accession, organism, 
         collection_date, env_broad_scale, env_local_scale, env_medium, 
         geo_loc_name, host, lat_lon, 
         response ,recist, irae, pfs_6m, age, sex, race, bmi, stage,
         melanoma_type, immunotherapy, charlson_comorbidity, recurrence_site)
```
